name: SkyPulse Arcade
subtitle: Flight & Signal Heist Puzzles
promotionalText: Three free modes: Endless flight, daily crystal-gate Relay and the new 3D Signal Heist. Created by Mcaulee Maddison for offline portrait play.
description:
SkyPulse Arcade is Mcaulee Maddison’s mechanical-bird and signal-routing arcade: three free offline modes with their own scenery, controls and progress.

ENDLESS ROUTE
Tap to flap, thread the gates and collect crystals as you chase your best. Travel from Neon City through Aurora Rise and Solar Drift to Cobalt Storm, Amber Skies and Polar Glow. Twelve environments change every 15 gates before the route repeats. Reflective cylindrical gate hardware adds depth to the illustrated worlds.

PULSE RELAY
Fly four fresh daily circuits through an orbital station. Collect both randomly placed crystals for each numbered gate. Red lasers guard each locked hoop. The first crystal charges half its ring; at 2/2 the lasers turn blue and the gate opens automatically. Missing crystals leave it locked. Tap freely to fly through hollow 3D hoops at varying heights, avoid the runway and reach the green exit to earn a medal. Each UTC day brings new named routes. Today’s routes and medals remain stable across app restarts. Fly past moving station machinery and rotating crystal cores with a single tap-to-flap control, then choose Next Mission after a clear.

BLACKOUT PROTOCOL
Restore eight systems of the city's signal grid through eight increasingly demanding Signal Heist vaults. Tap prisms to rotate mirrors and route live energy on a 3D optical console. Light every core and reach the uplink to restore each system. Splitters divide beams; energized relays open matching shutters. Red sensors can raise a move's trace cost. Use PLAN to see the next rotation, its dashed beam path and exact trace cost without spending, then confirm or return to live play. Every committed turn spends trace. Each extraction saves your medal, brings a system online and immediately activates the next puzzle. Restart a failed attempt or return to your saved unfinished configuration.

DAILY MISSION CONTROL
Complete four tasks across your attempts and claim five crystals for each, up to 20 daily-task crystals per UTC day. The daily reset time appears in your local time zone.

BUILD YOUR COLLECTION
Unlock 15 founder birds with different combinations of collection, salvage, perfect-pass, distance and recovery rewards in Endless Route. Train each bird as your Core allows, up to level 5. Evolve the SkyPulse Core through Ion, Jade, Prism, Solar and Nova: each has its own colour and halo motion. Core levels raise training limits and lineage capacity, and reduce Tech Tree, training and breeding prices by 5% at Jade, 10% at Prism, 15% at Solar and 20% at Nova.

Breeding unlocks at Core level 2. Choose two owned parents and preview the exact inherited traits and crystal cost. Both parents stay in your Hangar. Offspring inherit the first parent's silhouette and a complementary pair of reward traits; train them and find them in the carousel. Train parents to level 3 to pass stronger grades within your Core’s limit. Higher Core levels allow up to 20 offspring. Identical owned combinations cannot charge you again. Every bird keeps the same flight handling, collision and gate-score rules.

Drag through one connected 3D holographic Tech Tree. Its nine upgrade families each have three clearly marked levels, with Installed, Next and Locked states. Existing upgrades remain available independently of Core levels. The run report separates bird-trait rewards from Tech bonuses. Mission medals and Endless best are saved separately.

THREE MODES, THREE HOMES
Home starts on Endless Route. Tap the top-left badge to select a free mode. Each Home has its own rendered 3D display, scenery, animation, progress and relevant controls: flight collection, Relay circuits and Bird Hangar, or Blackout vault map and field guide.

Return to the selected mode’s Home with Main Menu after each run. Portrait play on iPhone and iPad, with Reduced Motion and haptic controls. Play offline with no advertising, account or real-money purchases. Progress and preferences are saved on your device.
